name: @grapix/desktop-tauri
description: GrapiX Editor desktop shell (Tauri 2 + WebView2). Runs the project service and ensures a render engine.

scripts.dev: npm --prefix ../../.. run build -w @grapix/api-server && cargo build --manifest-path ../../../services/render-engine/Cargo.toml && tauri dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix ../../.. run build -w @grapix/api-server && cargo build --release --manifest-path ../../../services/render-engine/Cargo.toml && tauri build
